dogecoin.text: This Just In! @Dogecoin has a renewed Dogecoin Foundation and joining it are @VitalikButerin and @elonmusk representative Jared Birchall. Read more: https://t.co/VQuXFtGYBG #crypto #DOGE #Dogecoin @DogecoinFdn $DOGE

The New #Dogecoin Foundation (@DogecoinFdn), which has added Vitalik Buterin (@VitalikButerin) and Elon Musk's (@elonmusk) rep. Jared Birchall as advisors, has set its eye on Liechtenstein for its HQ, as reported by @decryptmedia. More: https://t.co/6VasLHngf0 #crypto $DOGE
